description: A shell script for bumping kernel versions within an OpenWrt git repository, including functions for initialization, requirement checks, and kernel file management.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse options, check requirements, initialize, bump kernel, and cleanup.

methods.name: check_requirements
methods.description: Checks for required external commands and reports missing ones.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes script variables, checks repository state, and sets up traps.

methods.name: bump_kernel
methods.description: Handles the process of bumping kernel versions, moving files, and managing git commits.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Restores git state and cleans up after the script execution.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: _msg
methods.description: Outputs messages with a specified log level.
